speaker: Pep Guardiola embargoed

Hi Pep, Ederson came off. Any updates on that?  No, one month or two months ago had the problems,  
muscular. That's why it was a few days out. But  when it went past to Gündogan, not to McAtee,  
he felt the same feeling. That's why he came out.  And also, Pep, on Gündogan, has he now triggered  
his contract for next season? And does... Kevin  leaving, does that sort of alter your thinking on  
him at all? How important is it that he stays?  No, he has one more year contract, definitely.  
What's going to happen? I don't know, but how more  year contract now? Has he been.. has he's been  
informed? The Gundo from Leicester, the Gundo from  Bournemouth, the Gundo from today is the Gundo I  
remember when we won the treble and quadruple and  an important player. So his activity, his space,  
his defensive intelligence arrived. So Gundo  had been with us massively. And as a team,  
we could not help him because it's not about you,  you, you. Everyone was down, was below because  
the team was not playing good. When the team  play good, the individual rise. Without that,  
in football, you cannot do it. Simon. Six goals  for Omar Marmoush since he came. Is he another  
player who can smell the goal and what have you  made of him since he? And his runners and when a  
team like likes to get the ball in the field,  he make a runner, he understood the intensity  
you have to play and yeah, look, he have one  goal again, could score easily. I don't know,  
in the first one it was a being pulled for their  for the defender and the last one for assist from  
Kevin with the score like Maka, three goals easy.  He's in front, one-on-one is the keeper. That is  
what the team had to try to do, deliver that.  And after score on a score, you had to demand  
to score. But the only way to score or to create  chances and score goals is play good. And today  
we did it. It's not easy coming to a new league  and it's not easy kind of stepping in to replace  
Erling Haaland, but he seems to be... The numbers  are really good. The numbers are really, really,  
really good. So arrive here in the middle of the  season and in the moment that we are not good,  
sometimes come one play whenever  it's fluid and everything is fine,  
it's easy to adapt. But come when the team is not  playing good in the other one, that is big value,  
big credit. Last one with Jamie, please guys. Hi,  Pep. In January, you brought in four new players.  
Seeing what you're seeing now towards the end  of this season, and having brought in four  
players in January, do you feel you need another  four, that sort of number in the summer, or one  
or two? No idea. Really? Really. No, no, it's  true. No idea. All the players are contracted,  
we'll see what happened. No idea. Is left back  a priority, if you may, because you haven't had  
a dedicated sort of career left back for a few  years? Obviously, Nico's helping us, but it's not  
a left back. That's true. So, I played with Alex  Zinchenko left back, with Philip... Fabian Delph  
left back. So, we find solutions many, many years.  We have to give another quality. They help us,  
Alex and Fabian, for example, or sometimes  Rico, when I play the fullbacks left on one,  
they help us massively. But yeah, of course we  don't have, of course we can have with Nathan,  
but Nathan, like John Stones, have been injured  all the season. So that's why the most important  
thing is, from my point of view, I said to the  club, which players are reliable for the future?  
You cannot perform if you are not reliable, you  are injured. So this is which players that we  
have, they can play every three days, three days,  three days, three days, or cannot play every three  
days, three days. And since then, build a squad  for the next season. Thank you, guys. Thank you.
title: Pep Guardiola embargoed post-match press conference | Manchester City 5-2 Crystal Palace
